help.name: The person's full name.
help.mobile: Mobile number, for example 01712345678. Bangla digits also work. In Excel, keep the cell type as Text.
help.role: Teacher, Accountant or another role of your school. Write the role name as it is in the app (Bangla or English).
help.designation: Optional. For example Assistant Teacher. It is used only for teachers; for another role, or if it is not recognised, it is dropped.
help.sendInvitations: If ticked, a link to activate the account goes to new staff by phone or email. Ticked to begin with. People who are brought back do not get it again.
